links.outcome: Anxiety symptom reduction with AI chatbot CBT versus peer-counselor CBT versus no-intervention control
links.effect: ITT analysis showed no significant advantage of either AI-CBT or peer-CBT over control at post-intervention; AI group reported significantly lower perceived treatment benefit than human group (p < 0.001).
links.quote: However, in the primary intention-to-treat analysis, neither intervention demonstrated a statistically significant advantage over the no-intervention control group at post-intervention.

screen.reason: This is a randomized controlled trial testing the clinical efficacy and user experience of an AI chatbot delivering CBT compared to human peer counselors and a control group in young adults with anxiety.
